messages:
ashley: Quick RFC follow-up — we need to pick where the compatibility shim lives: edge-router rewrite vs client SDK helper. Original RFC laid out both but didn't pick. Thoughts?

mike: leaning edge-router. centralizes telemetry + we can enforce quotas/SLAs. client-side divergent versions are messy. :+1:

jordan: agree on telemetry but worried about semantics drift. server rewrites risk silently changing behavior. we should make rewrites explicit and observable.

kevin: +1 to observable. add config to opt tenants in/out. Also we need circuit breaker — if rewrite increases latency >50ms or error rate spikes, rollback automatic.

deploy-bot: canary deploy v0.3-compat-shim to us-east immediately — logs: canary started (id: c-7738). ETA 30m

ashley: proposal: implement a limited translational shim in edge-router that only rewrites a small set of stable fields (payload->body mapping, header normalizations) — 80% of clients covered. Rewrites only when client sets header `X-Compat-AutoRewrite: true` or tenant has opt-in flag.

jordan: sounds reasonable. Also add a non-mutating probe endpoint `/internal/_compat/features` that SDKs can call to detect available transforms. SDKs should surface a warning if compat header absent.

ashley: example probe response (pseudo):
```
200 {
 "tenant_id": "t-123",
 "supported_rewrites": ["payload.v1->body.v2", "header:Accept->accept-version"],
 "unsafe_rewrites": ["streaming-frame-remap"]
}
```

mike: we should also return `latency_budget_ms` recommended and `telemetry_token` for clients to tag calls. helps monitor per-tenant.

kevin: rollout plan: 1) canary 5 tenants with edge-shim + probe; 2) collect errors + token-latency delta; 3) expand to 25%; 4) default opt-in for SDKs after 3 months if metrics good; 5) deprecation window 6 months after GA.

jordan: metric thresholds? error rate <0.5% and median latency delta <20ms for stable.

ashley: agreed. action items: @mike wire up rewrite whitelist + telemetry token, @jordan spec probe endpoint, @kevin add canary circuit-breaker. I'll draft short doc and email product for customer comms. :rocket:

mike: will add telemetry keys to rollout dashboard.

deploy-bot: canary health check: 2/5 failing tests (request shape mismatch). rolling back canary nodes to previous version.

ashley: thanks — let's triage those failing shapes before reattempt. I'll link failing payload examples in the doc.
